51:# Back up the base image libapk before overwriting (node image ships an older
52:# libapk with the same SONAME, which would break the apk binary)
53:RUN cp /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0 /usr/local/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0.base
55:# Copy files from node image
57:# Restore the base image libapk so apk keeps working
58:RUN cp /usr/local/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0.base /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -n 'libapk\|Copy files from node' docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
